products.heading: Our products
products.harmonculus.title: Harmonculus
products.harmonculus.tagline: Sculpt the sound. Play the music.
products.harmonculus.summary: An additive synthesiser that turns samples into playable instruments. Shape the individual harmonics and how they move over time.
products.harmonculus.image_alt: Harmonculus showing the Crossing Harmonic Bands preset and its multicoloured 3D partial surface
products.taype.title: TayPE
products.taype.summary: A tape-inspired recording workstation for making records with the immediacy of an analogue studio.
products.taype.image_alt: TayPE’s tape machine with two white reels above a multitrack mixer
products.vocoder.title: Vintage Vocoder
products.vocoder.summary: A stereo vocoder with eight tuned carrier oscillators, a multimode filter and a vintage hardware interface.
products.vocoder.image_alt: Vintage Vocoder’s wood-panelled editor with its carrier oscillator, filter and analysis controls
products.mpc.title: MPC Plugin Loader
products.mpc.summary: Install and play third-party plugins on a standalone Akai MPC with the RAW Plugin Loader and USB Creator.
products.mpc.image_alt: RAW MPC USB Creator showing the bundled plugins and USB destination steps
